PHPATHDEL.summary: Deletes a path in a path hash, optionally including all paths with that byte prefix.
PHPATHDEL.complexity: O(L + S) when deleting an exact path, where L is the path length and S is the number of fields in its payload. O(L + sum(P_i + F_i)) with WITHSUBPATHS, where P_i is the length of each matched path and F_i is the number of fields in its payload.
